acquisition method: Subsequently, triplex-labeled BSA peptides were mixed at ratios of 1:1:1, 1:5:10, and 10:5:1 and analyzed with DIA; LC–MS/MS raw files measured in DDA mode were analyzed with PEAKS X+
cleavage agent: amine-reactive NHS ester reacting with the epsilon-amino group of the C-terminal Lys residues in peptides generated by LysC digestion
collision energy: Neutral loss of Ac-Ile is complete, and peptide backbone fragmentation is efficient at a NCE of 30, which was therefore selected for further experiments.
fragmentation method: the isotopically labeled Ac-Ile part leaves as a neutral loss upon collision-induced dissociation
instrument: The mass shift between the Ac-IP tags is 1 Da, which allows us to work at a customary resolution of 70 k for MS1 and 17.5 k for MS2 spectra in an Orbitrap.
labeling: synthesized an isotopically labeled acetyl-isoleucine-proline (Ac-IP) tag for multiplexed quantification in DIA.
precursor tolerance: A tolerance of 20 ppm for the precursor ion and 0.02 Da for the MS/MS fragment ions was applied.
fragment tolerance: A tolerance of 20 ppm for the precursor ion and 0.02 Da for the MS/MS fragment ions was applied.
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethylation (+57.02) on cysteine; fixed dimethylation (+28.03) on the N-terminus; variable oxidation (+15.99) on methionine; variable Ac-IP (+252.1474) on Lys; variable 13C1-Ac-IP (+253.1508) on Lys; variable 13C2-Ac-IP (+254.1542) on Lys
